newsitem.title: USA: Medi-Ject issued gas spring patent.
newsitem.headline: Medi-Ject issued gas spring patent.

text.p: Medi-Ject Corp said Tuesday the U.S. Patent Office issued it a patent covering the use of the company's gas spring technology as a power source for needle-free injection systems.
Prior to this time, the energy to deliver drugs by commercial needle-free injection systems was limited to air compressors, CO2 cartridges or coil springs.

The gas spring has advantages over other energy sources by virtue of its greater efficiency, the company said. Medi-Ject plans to incorporate the gas spring into a needle-free injection system for the delivery of insulin.
